verdict.rationale: Lovable explicitly documents multi-person collaboration ('Invite your designer, developer, agency... everyone sees changes as they happen') and describes a workspace model where each teammate works in their own draft/copy with shared syncing back to the project. This directly supports a shared team workspace, but the evidence lacks detail on roles/permissions, real-time conflict handling, or independent hands-on validation of team collaboration specifically. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-user collaboration in practice, details on permission levels or roles, and evidence of how conflicting edits across drafts are merged.
